query: What closed-loop simulator calibration procedure (parameter-update schedule, quantitative acceptance criteria, two-sample thresholds, and rollback rules) will reliably reduce simulator bias?

response.query: What closed-loop simulator calibration procedure (parameter-update schedule, quantitative acceptance criteria, two-sample thresholds, and rollback rules) will reliably reduce simulator bias?
response.answer: A closed-loop simulator calibration procedure involves regular parameter updates, strict quantitative acceptance criteria, defined two-sample thresholds, and rollback rules to minimize simulator bias. This ensures accurate simulation results and reliable performance predictions.
